notes: Assumptions that move the number: a cleaned, butterflied 1.8 kg snoek yields ~55 % edible flesh (990 g, head, backbone, fins and fine bones out); raw snoek at 122 kcal / 100 g from the SA proximate study (FatSecret's Cape Point braai snoek lists 94 kcal / 100 g, which would take ~50 kcal off each plate); all the glaze is eaten, because the recipe pours what is left over the fish; a third of the grid oil reaches the fish. No published per-serving kcal was found. The Fish Society's version (1.2 kg snoek, 80 g butter, 180 g jam, serves 4) gives ~450 kcal a serving from the same reference values. Ours, with more fish per gram of glaze but 6 servings, gives 400.
